run_segmentation_with_dinov3: run semantic segmentation using a DINOv3 backbone model with a given config for training or testing
test_segmentation_with_pretrained_head: test model performance on a pretrained decoder head by running segmentation with a load_from config
train_segmentation_with_linear_head: train a linear decoder head for semantic segmentation using a DINOv3 backbone model
benchmark_launcher: launch a segmentation benchmark by loading config, backbone model, and running evaluation or training
main_cli_entry: run the segmentation benchmark CLI entry point that parses args and launches the benchmark pipeline
